Biology.description: Biology explores living organisms, genetics, ecology, and human physiology. Students develop analytical and practical lab skills.

Chemistry.description: Chemistry focuses on chemical reactions, atomic structure, bonding, and practical laboratory investigations.

Physics.description: Physics examines motion, forces, energy, electricity, waves, and modern physics concepts.

Agricultural Science.description: Agricultural Science covers farming practices, soil science, animal physiology, and sustainable food production.

English.description: English develops skills in comprehension, composition, comparative study, and poetry analysis.

Irish.description: Irish focuses on reading, writing, listening, and spoken fluency, with emphasis on cultural understanding.

Mathematics.description: Mathematics builds problem‑solving skills through algebra, geometry, trigonometry, and calculus.

Business.description: Business explores enterprise, management, finance, and the role of organisations in society.

Accounting.description: Accounting focuses on financial statements, budgeting, cost analysis, and business decision‑making.

Economics.description: Economics examines markets, government policy, inflation, employment, and global trade.

French.description: French develops communication skills through reading, writing, listening, and oral expression.

Spanish.description: Spanish focuses on practical communication, grammar, listening, and cultural understanding.

German.description: German develops linguistic skills through comprehension, oral work, grammar, and written tasks.

Italian.description: Italian emphasises communication, grammar, listening, and cultural awareness.

Polish.description: Polish focuses on reading, writing, listening, and oral fluency for heritage and non‑native speakers.

Russian.description: Russian develops comprehension, grammar, vocabulary, and cultural understanding.

Japanese.description: Japanese includes reading, writing, listening, speaking, and cultural studies.

Arabic.description: Arabic focuses on reading, writing, listening, and oral communication with emphasis on grammar.

Mandarin Chinese.description: Mandarin develops communication skills through characters, listening, speaking, and cultural learning.

History.description: History explores political, social, and cultural developments through research and document analysis.

Geography.description: Geography examines physical landscapes, human activity, and environmental interactions.

Classical Studies.description: Classical Studies explores ancient Greek and Roman civilisation, literature, and archaeology.

Religious Education.description: Religious Education examines world religions, ethics, and philosophical questions.

Politics & Society.description: Politics & Society explores citizenship, human rights, political systems, and social change.

Home Economics.description: Home Economics covers nutrition, family studies, textiles, and practical cookery.

Music.description: Music develops performance, composition, and listening analysis skills.

Art.description: Art focuses on practical creativity, art history, and design skills.

DCG.description: Design & Communication Graphics teaches 3D modelling, technical drawing, and design principles.

Construction Studies.description: Construction Studies covers building design, materials, and practical woodworking skills.

Engineering.description: Engineering teaches metalwork, mechanics, design, and manufacturing processes.

Technology.description: Technology explores electronics, systems, design, and problem‑solving.

Computer Science.description: Computer Science covers programming, problem‑solving, algorithms, and computational thinking.

LCPE.description: Leaving Certificate Physical Education focuses on performance, movement, and sports science.

Applied Maths.description: Applied Maths develops problem‑solving skills through mechanics, motion, and mathematical modelling.
